description: Speaker diarization: who speaks when, in turns, with no words. Finds the number of voices by itself and handles overlapping speech. Pair it with a transcriber to give each heard word its voice. Experimental.

settings.label: Overlapping speech
settings.description: Off: one voice at a time, the one that talks most when several do (what you want for pairing with a transcript). On: every voice that talks, so turns can overlap.

settings.label: Merge distance
settings.description: How different two stretches of speech must be to start as different voices (the model's own value is 0.6). Lower: more voices, and similar ones stay apart (try 0.5 when two people are taken for one). Higher: more merging.

settings.label: Acoustic weight
settings.description: How much the final grouping trusts how the voices sound (the model's value is 0.07). Higher: more voices. Sensitive: on a 5 minute podcast 0.2 found one more voice, 0.3 found two more, and 0.5 or more found a dozen. Change it in small steps.

settings.label: Voice-count penalty
settings.description: How much the final grouping dislikes extra voices (the model's value is 0.8). Lower: more voices, higher: fewer. Below about 0.3 it finds a dozen or more.

settings.label: Shortest voice
settings.description: How much of a 10 s window a voice must speak alone to help tell the voices apart (the model's value is 0.2). Lower: brief replies and interjections count, so short speakers are found more easily, at the risk of noise.

settings.label: At least
settings.description: The fewest voices to find. 0: no limit. Ignored when the number of voices is given with the request.

settings.label: At most
settings.description: The most voices to find. 0: no limit. Ignored when the number of voices is given with the request.
